questions.question_markdown:
19. 已知圆 $O: x^2 + y^2 = 9$ 与 $x$ 轴的正半轴交于点 $P$，以 $P$ 为圆心，半径为 $r$ 的圆与圆 $O$ 相交于 $M, N$ 两点。
(1) 过点 $A(3,1)$ 的直线与圆 $O$ 相切，求切线方程；
(2) $D$ 为圆 $O$ 上的动点（异于点 $P$），若线段 $PD$ 上有一点 $E$，满足 $\overrightarrow{PE} = 2\overrightarrow{ED}$，求点 $E$ 的轨迹方程；
(3) 若 $Q$ 是圆 $O$ 上任意一点（不与 $M, N$ 重合），直线 $QM, QN$ 分别与 $x$ 轴交于点 $K$ 和 $T$，则 $|OK| \cdot |OT|$ 是否为定值？若是，求出该定值；若不是，请说明理由。

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: C001 context and answer_detail_01 show red-pen handwriting only for (3), matching the draft line by line: setup M(x_0,y_0), Q(x_1,y_1), (y_1 ≠ ±y_0); N(x_0,-y_0); x_0^2+y_0^2=9 and x_1^2+y_1^2=9; l_QM: y-y_1=(y_0-y_1)/(x_0-x_1)(x-x_1); l_QN: y-y_1=(-y_0-y_1)/(x_0-x_1)(x-x_1); setting y=0 gives x_K=(x_1y_0-x_0y_1)/(y_0-y_1) and x_T=(x_1y_0+x_0y_1)/(y_0+y_1); then |OK|·|OT|=|x_K·x_T| expanded through two absolute-value fractions to '= 9'. The (1) and (2) areas contain no handwriting, consistent with the draft's unrecognized-answer markers.

page_notes: In the (3) working, a short horizontal dash before x_1 y_0 on the x_T line and a P-like opening glyph before (x_1, y_1) on the setup line are ink-level ambiguities; neither is conclusive enough to patch, so draft readings are kept.
